title: My Little Cat
poem_text:
My little cat is soft and small,
It likes to play with a tiny ball.
It runs around and jumps so high,
Then curls to sleep when night is nigh.

title: Sunny Day
poem_text:
The sun is bright up in the sky,
White clouds slowly pass me by.
I feel the warmth upon my face,
It makes the day a happy place.

title: The Busy Bee
poem_text:
A little bee flies in the air,
It visits flowers here and there.
It gathers nectar all day long,
While humming softly in its song.

title: My Red Ball
poem_text:
I have a ball so big and red,
I bounce it high above my head.
It rolls away across the floor,
Then comes right back to me once more.

title: The Little Bird
poem_text:
A little bird sings in a tree,
Its song is sweet and full of glee.
It flaps its wings and flies so high,
Then glides across the clear blue sky.

title: Rainy Fun
poem_text:
The rain falls down in tiny drops,
It lands on roofs and never stops.
I wear my coat and boots so tight,
And jump in puddles with delight.

title: My Best Friend
poem_text:
My best friend walks along with me,
We laugh and play so happily.
We share our toys and help each day,
And never let our smiles go away.

title: The Big Tree
poem_text:
The big tree stands so tall and wide,
With birds and nests all tucked inside.
Its leaves are green and shade is cool,
A perfect place to rest from school.

title: Morning Time
poem_text:
The sun comes up to start the day,
The birds wake up and fly away.
I brush my teeth and wash my face,
Then get ready at a steady pace.

title: At the Park
poem_text:
I run and play at the park so wide,
I swing and slide with joy and pride.
The grass is green, the sky is blue,
There’s so much fun for me to do.

title: The Shiny Moon
poem_text:
The moon shines bright up in the sky,
It watches as the clouds pass by.
The stars all twinkle in the night,
Together making a lovely sight.

title: My Pet Dog
poem_text:
My pet dog runs fast and free,
It wags its tail and plays with me.
It barks out loud and guards our home,
But never likes to be alone.

title: The Windy Day
poem_text:
The wind blows strong from left to right,
It lifts the leaves and kites in flight.
It whistles softly through the air,
And moves the trees without a care.

title: The Busy Street
poem_text:
Cars and buses move so fast,
People walk and hurry past.
Lights turn red and then to green,
A busy street is always seen.

title: A Day at School
poem_text:
At school I learn and read each day,
I write and listen as teachers say.
I answer questions and try my best,
Then go outside and take a rest.
